title.zh-TW: 輝達財報優於預期，上調明年營收成長預估
title.en: Nvidia results beat expectations and it raises next-year growth outlook

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引述法新社、路透報導，輝達第三季營收倍增至逾1150億美元、獲利653億美元，並把明年營收成長預估由70%上調至75%；盤後股價漲近5%。75%為公司預估，不是已實現數字。
summary.en: CNA, citing AFP and Reuters, reports Nvidia's third-quarter revenue doubled to more than US$115 billion with profit of US$65.3 billion, and it lifted its next-year revenue growth outlook from 70% to 75%. Shares rose nearly 5% after hours. The 75% figure is a company forecast.

impact.zh-TW: 財報緩解 AI 需求疑慮，但領導層更替與對中管制仍是變數；預估上調不代表各供應商訂單同步增加。
impact.en: Results eased AI demand worries, but leadership change and China controls remain variables; a higher outlook does not establish matching orders for every supplier.

title.zh-TW: 輝達表示已停止向中國出貨獲許可的 Hopper 產品
title.en: Nvidia says it has stopped shipping licensed Hopper products to China

summary.zh-TW: 路透報導，輝達代理執行長 Colette Kress 在財報會議表示，截至10月25日的季度售予中國24億美元獲許可 Hopper 資料中心產品，但目前已停止出貨，財測不含此部分；未說明原因或是否永久。
summary.en: Reuters reports interim CEO Colette Kress said on the earnings call that Nvidia sold US$2.4 billion of licensed Hopper data-center products to China in the quarter ended October 25 but is no longer shipping them, and guidance excludes them. She did not say why or whether the halt is permanent.

impact.zh-TW: 中國市場貢獻不確定性升高；停止出貨是否影響上游晶圓與封裝排程，需看後續公司說明。
impact.en: Uncertainty over China revenue rises; whether the halt affects upstream wafer or packaging schedules depends on later company disclosures.

title.zh-TW: 美國會諮詢機構年報：中國軍方尋求取得先進 AI 晶片
title.en: US commission report says China's military seeks advanced AI chips

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引述路透，美中經濟暨安全審查委員會11/18發布年報，指中國試圖規避出口管制取得輝達先進晶片用於 AI 武器，並評估華為昇騰等國產晶片仍落後輝達與 AMD。此為委員會評估，非執法結論。
summary.en: CNA, citing Reuters, says the US-China Economic and Security Review Commission's annual report, released November 18, finds China seeking to evade export controls to obtain advanced Nvidia chips for AI weapons, and assesses domestic chips such as Huawei Ascend still trail Nvidia and AMD. It is a commission assessment, not an enforcement finding.

impact.zh-TW: 報告可能強化管制討論，但年報建議不等於已立法或新禁令生效。
impact.en: The report may intensify control debates, but its recommendations are not enacted law or new bans in force.

title.zh-TW: 新加坡總理稱願協助美國檢查 AI 晶片使用情形
title.en: Singapore PM offers to help US check AI chip use

summary.zh-TW: 中央社引述法新社，新加坡總理黃循財表示願協助美方檢查先進 AI 晶片在當地的使用，並研究美方防止中企在東南亞租用算力的新措施；新規要求出貨新加坡、馬來西亞等地的先進晶片須申請許可。
summary.en: CNA, citing AFP, says Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong offered to help the US check how advanced AI chips are used in Singapore and is studying new US measures against Chinese firms renting compute in Southeast Asia. The rules require licences for advanced-chip shipments to Singapore, Malaysia and others.

impact.zh-TW: 東南亞資料中心的出貨許可與合規流程可能拉長交期；實際影響需看許可核發情況。
impact.en: Licensing and compliance for Southeast Asian data centers may lengthen lead times; actual impact depends on how licences are granted.

title.zh-TW: 台股11/18震盪1677點收漲102點，外資連三賣
title.en: Taiwan stocks swing 1,677 points, close up 102 as foreigners sell

summary.zh-TW: 中央社報導，加權指數收40194.91點、漲102.8點，盤中高低差1677點；台積電收2175元、聯發科漲2.6%。外資賣超約765.6億元、連三日累計逾1848億元，群創為外資主要買超個股之一。
summary.en: CNA reports the TAIEX closed at 40,194.91, up 102.8 points after a 1,677-point intraday range; TSMC closed at NT$2,175 and MediaTek rose 2.6%. Foreign investors net sold about NT$76.6 billion, over NT$184.8 billion across three sessions; Innolux was among their top net buys.

impact.zh-TW: 指數守住4萬點但波動仍大，外資持續賣超；單日收紅不代表賣壓結束。
impact.en: The index held 40,000 but volatility stays high with continued foreign selling; one up day does not mean selling pressure has ended.

reason.zh-TW: 報導指台積電為輝達生產 H200，且11/18收2175元；關注輝達對中出貨停止與財測對先進製程需求的訊號。
reason.en: Reports say TSMC makes Nvidia's H200, and it closed at NT$2,175 on November 18; watch signals from Nvidia's China halt and outlook for advanced-node demand.

risk.zh-TW: 出口管制擴大、外資持續調節，對中出貨停止的影響尚未量化。
risk.en: Wider export controls, continued foreign selling, and an unquantified effect from the China halt.

reason.zh-TW: 中央社報導聯發科11/18漲2.6%，屬當日反彈的權值股；觀察 AI 情緒回溫能否延續。
reason.en: CNA reports MediaTek rose 2.6% on November 18 among rebounding heavyweights; watch whether improved AI sentiment persists.

risk.zh-TW: 大盤高波動，單日漲幅可能反轉；終端需求與競爭變化。
risk.en: High market volatility may reverse one-day gains; end-demand and competition shifts.

reason.zh-TW: 產業推論：輝達財報與上調預估攸關 AI 伺服器組裝需求；報導未直接提及廣達。
reason.en: Industry inference: Nvidia's results and higher outlook bear on AI server assembly demand; the reports do not name Quanta.

risk.zh-TW: 輝達策略或客戶結構改變可能壓縮組裝毛利；東南亞出貨許可延長交期。
risk.en: Changes in Nvidia strategy or customer mix may pressure assembly margins; Southeast Asian licensing may delay shipments.

reason.zh-TW: 產業推論：資料中心建置帶動電源與散熱需求，11/18散熱族群反彈；報導未直接提及台達電。
reason.en: Industry inference: data-center build-outs drive power and thermal demand, and thermal stocks rebounded on November 18; the reports do not name Delta.

risk.zh-TW: AI 資本支出放緩、管制使海外資料中心專案延後。
risk.en: Slower AI capex or controls delaying overseas data-center projects.

reason.zh-TW: 中央社報導外資整體賣超之際，群創為外資買超前段個股；觀察資金輪動是否延續。
reason.en: CNA reports Innolux was among foreign investors' top net buys amid broad net selling; watch whether the rotation continues.

risk.zh-TW: 單日法人買超不代表趨勢，面板景氣與報價波動。
risk.en: One day of net buying is not a trend; panel cycle and price volatility.
